item.name: FluxPro流转表盘
item.description:
# FluxPro 表盘 **一块会流动的表盘。** *A watch face that flows.* 屏幕分上下两层，各一套颜色。每一秒，上层的下沿往下退一点，一分钟退完，整块屏幕被另一种颜色接管；到点两层互换，接着流下去。所以你看到的不是跳变，而是一分钟一次的、无缝的颜色接力。 *The screen is two layers, each with its own palette. Every second the upper layer's lower edge recedes a little; after one minute it's gone and the other color has taken over. Then the two palettes swap and the flow continues — a seamless hand-off of color, once a minute.* **三种风格 / Three styles** | 经典 Classic | 渐变 Gradient | 线条 Line | | --- | --- | --- | | 大数字，经典不过时
*Big numerals, quietly timeless* | 多一层纹理，更有体积
*An extra texture layer for depth* | 描边数字 + 水线，最显手细
*Outline digits + waterline, the lightest look on the wrist* | **100+ 组**成对配色 · **200+ 张**单层配色 · **10+ 种**材质 *100+ color pairs · 200+ single palettes · 10 materials* --- ## 支持型号 / Supported devices | 型号 / Model | | --- | | 小米手环 10 / Xiaomi Smart Band 10 | | 小米手环 10 Pro / Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro | | 小米手环 9 Pro / Xiaomi Smart Band 9 Pro | | 红米手表 6 / Redmi Watch 6 | 含电量、日期、步数、心率、天气、风向；抬腕渐亮可关闭；八种界面语言，两处自定义跳转。 *Battery, date, steps, heart rate, weather and wind direction included. The wake fade can be turned off. Eight interface languages, two custom shortcuts.* ## 问题反馈 / Feedback - QQ 群 / QQ group：**114772806** 新配色不定时更新，后续更新免费。 *New palettes are added from time to time. One-time purchase — all future updates included.*
